entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: 199 aa protein containing a Ham1p_like domain (PF01725.22; residues 3–191).
Strongly matches reviewed dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases: 65.8–71.6% identity and 99–100% query coverage.
Likely homodimeric Mg2+-dependent nucleotide pyrophosphatase by homology.

entities.name: dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: Hydrolyzes noncanonical purine nucleoside triphosphates to the corresponding monophosphate and diphosphate.

entities.name: XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate
observations: Rhea RHEA:28610; candidate reaction supported by close reviewed homologs.

entities.name: dITP + H2O → dIMP + diphosphate
observations: Rhea RHEA:28342; candidate reaction supported by close reviewed homologs.

entities.name: ITP + H2O → IMP + diphosphate
observations: Rhea RHEA:29399; candidate reaction supported by close reviewed homologs.

entities.name: Magnesium cofactor
observations: Close reviewed homologs bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit; Mg2+ is inferred for the query enzyme.
